title: NYC-based Taktile, which helps fintechs build automated decision-making workflows, raised a $110M Series C led by Goldman Sachs, and plans a São Paulo office (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
summary: Camila Grigera Naón / Fortune: NYC-based Taktile, which helps fintechs build automated decision-making workflows, raised a $110M Series C led by Goldman Sachs, and plans a São Paulo office — Banks and insurance companies spend billions of dollars to employ staff to screen risky transactions, process claims, and onboard new customers.
